# {{name}}

> {{name}} is a free Hindu baby name finder. Enter the baby's birth date, time and place; it works out the nakshatra (birth star), pada and traditional naming syllable from the Moon's position, then lists matching names ranked Best, Good or Avoid by Chaldean numerology. It has {{count}} Hindu and Indian baby names, each with its meaning, origin and source.

{{name}} is free with no ads, on the web at {{origin}}/ and as an Android app ({{playUrl}}). It works offline and birth details never leave the device. Made by {{makerName}} ({{makerUrl}}).

Naming traditions and numerology charts differ between families and practitioners; the suggestions are a starting point, not a substitute for a family priest or astrologer.

## Use it

- [Find names for a birth date, time and place]({{origin}}/)
- [How it works: panchang, ayanamsa and numerology]({{origin}}/method)

## Browse names

- [All Hindu baby names with meanings]({{origin}}/names)
- [Hindu baby boy names]({{origin}}/names/boy)
- [Hindu baby girl names]({{origin}}/names/girl)
- One page per name: {{origin}}/names/NAME in lower case (for example {{origin}}/names/aarav) gives the meaning, the nakshatra and rashi it suits, and its numerology
